claims.content: To ensure filter management on the interface by coordinating transmit filters, including data forwarding filters, via voice coordination in addition to the filter message.

goal.raw_text: To ensure filter management on the interface by coordinating transmit filters, including data forwarding filters, via voice coordination in addition to the filter message.

claims.content: C2 JU

The C2 JU must have correlated local sensor data for the track if it is reporting a TQ value on the Surveillance NPG obtained via a J12.6 Target Sorting message from a nonC2 JU, to avoid applying extrapolation rules.
Voice coordination capability must be available in addition to the filter message mechanism to ensure filter management on the interface.
A JU requests that a filter be implemented by another JU, or reports a filter which the JU has inserted into its TDS, or responds to a J7.1 (ACT = 0) message.

trigger.raw_text: A JU requests that a filter be implemented by another JU, or reports a filter which the JU has inserted into its TDS, or responds to a J7.1 (ACT = 0) message.

claims.content: The C2 JU determines the filter types and parameters for each type, specifying whether to filter inside or outside the defined area.
The C2 JU sends a J7.6 (ACT = 0) message to request that a filter be implemented by another JU, with the Filter Number field set to value 0.
If specific filters have been prearranged, the C2 JU specifies the filter number with all Filter Indicator fields of the J7.6 (ACT = 0) set to value 0.
The C2 JU performs voice coordination in addition to sending the filter message to ensure filter management on the interface.
If specific filters have been prearranged, the C2 JU may implement the request by specifying the filter number with all Filter Indicator fields of the J7.6 (ACT = 0) set to value 0.
Instead of an implementation request, the C2 JU may send a J7.6 (ACT = 1) message to report a filter which the JU has inserted into its TDS or to respond to a J7.1 (ACT = 0) message.
The C2 JU may send a J7.6 (ACT = 2) Delete Filter Request/Report message to manage existing filters.
If a C2 JU reports a real-time track, it must report the position of the track extrapolated to the time of transmission; failure to do so would be an exception to proper reporting rules.
Nonreal-time data shall be identified as such and time tags shall be provided. Nonreal-time track positions shall not be extrapolated; attempting to extrapolate them would be an error.
A new filter report on a previously received filter number from a JU shall supersede prior filter data for that number. If this does not happen correctly, it represents a data consistency exception.

In the case of a line or area filter requiring multiple messages all with the same filter number, all of the messages must be treated as a single filter report. Failure to treat them as a single report constitutes an exception in filter description processing.
Filter management on the interface has been ensured through the use of voice coordination in addition to the filter message.

Transmit filters, including data forwarding filters, have been coordinated between JUs as specified by the Filter Unit Type field indicating whether the filter applies to individual JU transmissions or forwarding unit transmissions of forwarded data.

If a J7.6 (ACT = 0) implementation request was sent, the requested filter types and parameters have been specified, including whether to filter inside or outside the defined area, with the Filter Number field set to value 0.
If specific filters were prearranged, the implementation request consisted of specifying the filter number with all Filter Indicator fields of the J7.6 (ACT = 0) set to value 0.

If a J7.6 (ACT = 1) Filter Description Report was sent, the filter number has been set to a value between 1 and 14, and if responding to a J7.1 (ACT = 0) message, the message(s) have been addressed to the JU requesting the filter information.
Any new filter report on a previously received filter number from a JU has superseded prior filter data for that number.
In the case of a line or area filter requiring multiple messages with the same filter number, all messages have been treated as a single filter report.
